description: This file contains the implementation of an ERPNext report for item-wise purchase register, including data retrieval, processing, and column configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, calling internal _execute with filters.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Performs data retrieval, processing, and returns report columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns based on filters and additional columns.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches purchase invoice items from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_aii_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves account mappings for stock received but not billed.

methods.name: get_purchase_receipts_against_purchase_order
methods.description: Maps purchase order details to purchase receipt parents.
